entities.summary: Leader of Cambodia (1941–1970 (King), 1993–2004 (King restored)). 'Father of independence'; abdicated 1955 to be PM (Sangkum); overthrown by Lon Nol 1970; allied with Khmer Rouge; restored as king 1993; abdicated 2004; died 2012
